copy.minecraft:ores: the game's ore tags (26.3 lists them all here)
copy.minecraft:guarded_by_piglins: mining a gold variant angers piglins, as gold ore does
copy.minecraft:piglin_loved: piglins take a gold variant item, as they take gold ore
copy.minecraft:snaps_goat_horn: a ramming goat loses a horn on it, as on the ore
copy.minecraft:overworld_carver_replaceables: caves and canyons cut through it, as through the ore
copy.minecraft:blocks_*: 26.3: fluid flow, motion, heightmaps, lava fire spread, dolphin jumps read these tags
copy.minecraft:causes_suffocation: 26.3: being inside it suffocates, as inside the ore
copy.minecraft:ice_melts_when_destroyed_above: 26.3: ice broken on top of it melts
copy.minecraft:sulfur_cube_swallowable: 26.3: the sulfur cube treats the item as it treats the ore
copy.c:ore_rates/*: convention: how much an ore drops (dense, singular)
copy.cobblemon:natural: Cobblemon counts it as a natural block, as the ore
copy.*:mineable/*: any mod's own tools mine it at full speed, as they mine the ore
copy.*:*_ores: a mod's own grouping of its ores (the skip list, checked first, keeps out placement lists)
copy.forge:*_ore: a mod's own grouping of its ore items (Ores Above Diamonds' recipes read it)
copy.theurgy:divination_rod_*: Theurgy's divination rod finds it, as it finds the ore
copy.scguns:metal_detectable: Scorched Guns' metal detector finds it, as it finds the ore
copy.immersiveengineering:mineable/*: the mod's own tools mine it at full speed
copy.mekanism:atomic_disassembler_ore: the disassembler's vein mode takes it
copy.oreganized:blows_lead_cloud: a lead variant releases lead dust like lead ore
copy.oreganized:silktouch_using_scribe: the scribe silk-touches it like the ore
copy.forge:conductive_blocks: Iter RPG: blocks its lightning conducts through
copy.forge:fire_element: Iter RPG: the fire element its spells read
copy.c:electricdrillblocks: Electrodynamics: what its electric drill can mine
copy.betternether:obsidian_breaker_mineable: BetterNether: what its obsidian breaker can mine
copy.wover:ores/nether: WorldWeaver (BetterNether): its list of Nether ores

skip.iceandfire:*dragon_cave*: Ice and Fire PLACES blocks from these lists in dragon caves: our variants would appear there
skip.occultism:drop_from/*: a mob's drop list: the possessed blaze would drop our variant
skip.wover:surfaces/nether/*: WorldWeaver (BetterNether) worldgen treats these as the Nether's surface rock: a placement list
